notes: Access: plain HTTP GET worked throughout (HTTP 200, no WAF/bot-block). Navigation discovery: the homepage mega-nav JSON DOES have a top-level 'New Arrivals' category, but its action routes to /page/explore-oasis-collection, NOT to a product listing - fetched that page and confirmed it is a themed marketing/editorial landing page (no h1, no product-count badge, no JSON-LD product names, only banner/CTA markup) for an 'Oasis Collection' launch, with its own sub_navigation pointing to Oasis-branded sub-pages (oasis-living-room-collection, oasis-bedroom-collection, oasis-dining-room-collection, explore-oasis-full-collection). Per the brief's 'Collection pages need inspection' rule this Oasis campaign was excluded (genuine themed marketing launch, not a recency listing) and NOT counted as the site's New Arrivals PLP despite occupying that exact nav slot. The literal /collection/new-arrivals URL (found via the collections sitemap, not via main nav - the nav slot was repurposed for Oasis) IS a genuine product listing (h1 'New Arrivals', badge '1056 Products', real JSON-LD product names) and is used here as the canonical New Arrivals row. It does not itself link to any of the per-room/per-type 'new-arrival(s)-X' collections below, and none of those link back to it or to each other - checked systematically via slug-presence grep across each page's HTML. These per-room pages were found only via the collections sitemap; each was opened and independently confirmed as a real product grid (h1 matching the target New-Arrivals term + exact product-count badge + JSON-LD product names, not editorial content), so they pass the brief's PLP-validity test, but because none is cross-linked from the main hub or current site nav their ongoing currency (whether the listed products are still the genuinely newest additions today, vs a frozen leftover from a past campaign) could not be independently verified - flagged accordingly rather than silently trusted. Excluded as out of scope: 'Latest Sofa Set Designs' (/collection/latest-sofa-set-designs, 8576 Products) - far too large and 'Latest' here is a marketing term for the full current sofa catalogue/styling guide, not a recency/new-arrivals concept. No local-language equivalents found (site is English-only).
